questions.stem: Calculate $(2 \times 10^3) \times (4 \times 10^5)$. Give your answer in standard form.
questions.explanation: Multiply the numbers: $2 \times 4 = 8$. Add the powers: $10^3 \times 10^5 = 10^8$. So the answer is $8 \times 10^8$.

questions.stem: Calculate $(6 \times 10^7) \div (3 \times 10^4)$. Give your answer in standard form.
questions.explanation: Divide the numbers: $6 \div 3 = 2$. Subtract the powers: $10^{7-4} = 10^3$. So the answer is $2 \times 10^3$.

questions.stem: Which of these is correctly written in standard form?
questions.explanation: In standard form, the number must be at least $1$ and less than $10$. Only $9.03$ satisfies $1 \leq 9.03 < 10$. The values $12.5$, $0.7$, and $10$ do not meet this requirement.
